name: rain-glass-background

frames.best_why: The wiped clear arc through the fog is clearly visible while the headline and droplets still read.

tagline: Rain beads on fogged glass over a dusk view; drag to wipe it clear.
summary: A tall window pane with a photo behind fogged glass, dotted with water droplets that gather, run and merge. Pressing and dragging wipes a clear streak through the fog that slowly clouds over again.
appearance: A full-bleed dusk view of dark hills and water, softened by haze and speckled with round droplets of different sizes, some dragging thin trails. Centred white text and two small calls to action sit over it.
behaviour: Droplets land, grow heavy and run down the pane, leaving thin clear trails, while the fog thickens back over time. Dragging across the glass wipes a broad clear band that removes the drops under the hand and then slowly fogs up again.
demo_content: The line "Stay in when it rains." with cabin copy and Find a weekend and See the cabins links.
search_phrases: hero behind a fogged rainy window
water droplets on glass landing page
wipe the fog to reveal the photo
drops running down a window interactive
moody cabin hero with rain on the pane
drag to clear mist off the screen
how to make foggy glass on a website
use_when: A travel, cabin or hotel hero wants atmosphere and a tactile reason for visitors to touch the screen.
avoid_when: It needs WebGL2 and a CORS-readable photo, and on touch the vertical drag also scrolls the page.
customise: Choose the photo with src, the headline with title, rain from 0 to 1, and disable wiping with interactive. Children replace the default paragraph and links.
weight_why: A WebGL2 fragment shader redrawn every frame plus two 2D canvases for drops and fog.

a11y.note: Reduced motion stops the loop on one static frame, but the wipe is pointer-only and only the headline is meaningful content.

issues: The grey paragraph over the busy dark scene is low contrast and hard to read in places.
On touch screens the drag to wipe competes with vertical page scrolling, so wiping is awkward.
polish_why: Convincing wet-glass shader and believable wiping; the body copy fights the backdrop.
